# OmegaStart

> OmegaStart is the modern full-stack TypeScript starter. Ship production apps in minutes, not weeks.

## About

OmegaStart is a production-ready monorepo starter built on TanStack Start, Bun, and Turborepo. It includes authentication (email/password + passkeys), type-safe API (oRPC), database (Drizzle ORM + PGlite/PostgreSQL), transactional emails (React Email + Resend), full-stack i18n (Paraglide JS), structured logging (Pino), CI/CD (GitHub Actions), and one-click deployment (Railway).

## Key Features

- Zero-config local database: PGlite runs PostgreSQL in-process, no Docker needed
- Type-safe from DB to UI: Drizzle schema types flow through oRPC to TanStack Query
- Auth: email/password + passkeys (WebAuthn) via Better Auth, with email verification
- Transactional emails: React Email templates + Resend, fully i18n-ready
- Full-stack i18n: Paraglide JS across frontend, backend, and email templates
- Feature flags: environment-validated, tree-shakeable, true/undefined signals
- Admin dashboard: role-guarded user management (ban, roles, sessions)
- Structured logging: Pino with oRPC integration and per-request IDs
- CI/CD: GitHub Actions with type checking, linting, and tests
- One-click deploy: Railway with auto-migrations and health checks

## Tech Stack

- Framework: TanStack Start (Vite + TanStack Router + Nitro)
- Language: TypeScript (type-checked via tsgo)
- API: oRPC + TanStack Query
- Database: Drizzle ORM + PGlite / PostgreSQL
- Auth: Better Auth (email/password, passkeys, admin)
- UI: shadcn v4 + Tailwind CSS 4 + Base UI
- Email: React Email + Resend
- i18n: Paraglide JS (frontend + backend + email)
- Logging: Pino
- Linting: Ultracite (Oxlint + Oxfmt)
- Package Manager: Bun
- Monorepo: Turborepo
- Deployment: Railway
- CI/CD: GitHub Actions
